Type a road network by wood flux

Source: R/desserte_flux.R
typer_desserte.Rd

Ports ForestRoadNetwork's "Road Type Determination": each tronçon is placed in a road class by flux thresholds (high flux -> primary, ... , low -> tertiary). Optionally, a share of a class's length is converted to temporary/winter roads, preferentially inside dedicated zones.

Usage

typer_desserte(graphe, seuils_flux, conversion_temporaire = NULL)

Arguments

graphe

A foretaccess_reseau_graphe carrying a flux column on its troncons (run calculer_flux() first).

seuils_flux

A named, ascending numeric vector of class lower bounds, e.g. c(tertiaire = 0, secondaire = 100, primaire = 500). Each tronçon is assigned the highest class whose bound it reaches.

conversion_temporaire

Optional list to convert part of a class into temporary roads: type (source class), proportion (0..1 of that class's length), cible (target label, default "temporaire") and optional zones (an sf of preferential areas).

Value

A foretaccess_desserte_typee object: troncons (sf with a type column), noeuds, sources (if any), recap (length per type) and the recall of seuils_flux.
